name: Land's End Beach
summary: At Kalimdor’s southern edge, Land's End Beach lies quiet beneath the sun. Tanaris’s southern mountains and the vast South Seas cut this coast off from the desert.

sections.title: The Edge of the World
sections.body:
Beyond Tanaris’s southern mountains, Land's End Beach meets the far southern edge of Kalimdor’s mainland. The sealed titan gateway to Uldum stands beyond the ranges. No desert route reaches this coast, so travelers must swim through the dangerous open waters of the South Seas.

Surf breaks on shifting sand along the barren shore. The cartels and desert explorers who live farther north around Gadgetzan rarely come here.

sections.title: Offshore Mysteries
sections.body: Unnamed islets lie beyond the beach’s breakers, with broad stretches of deep water between them and the mainland. Reaching these rocks can exhaust even seasoned swimmers. Few mortals have reason to seek out the lonely waters at Kalimdor’s end, so the beach and nearby shoals remain undisturbed beneath the southern sun.

faq.q: Where is Land's End Beach located?
aliases: how to find lands end beach
faq.answer: Land's End Beach follows Tanaris’s southernmost coast, south of the mountains that seal off the ancient titan gates of Uldum, at Kalimdor’s far southern tip.

faq.q: How do you reach Land's End Beach?
aliases: how do i get to lands end beach
faq.answer: The southern mountain ranges block overland travel from the desert interior. Travelers must swim along the southern coast from eastern Tanaris or cross the perilous open waters, where deep-sea fatigue threatens them.

faq.q: What is on the islands off the coast of the beach?
faq.answer: Unnamed, remote islands lie far off the shore across a broad channel of deep ocean. These desolate rocky spits have seen few travelers, and few have explored them.

faq.q: Does anyone live on Land's End Beach?
faq.answer: No major settlements line the shore. Cut off from trade and civilization, Land's End Beach remains a barren natural shore exposed to ocean winds.
